votes.sql:
SELECT s.sname,
       MIN(s."NumTstTakr", f."Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS "Simultaneous Count"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."NumTstTakr" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    s.cds,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr <= f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" THEN s.NumTstTakr
        ELSE CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS INTEGER)
    END AS num_students_both
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL 
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL

votes.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.cds,
           s.AvgScrMath,
           f."Academic Year",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cds ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC) AS rn
    FROM satscores s
    LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
)
SELECT TRIM(sch."AdmFName1" || ' ' || sch."AdmLName1") AS administrator_name,
       sch."School" AS school_name,
       ranked."Academic Year" AS academic_year
FROM ranked
JOIN schools sch ON ranked.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
  AND ranked.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL;

JOIN schools sc ON f."CDSCode" = sc."CDSCode"

WITH admin_schools AS (
    SELECT AdmEmail1 AS email, School AS school_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND trim(AdmEmail1) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmEmail2, School, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND trim(AdmEmail2) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmEmail3, School, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND trim(AdmEmail3) <> ''
),
multi_admins AS (
    SELECT email
    FROM admin_schools
    GROUP BY email
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT District) > 1
)
SELECT a.email, a.school_name
FROM admin_schools a
JOIN multi_admins m ON a.email = m.email
ORDER BY a.email, a.school_name;

votes.sql:
WITH maxpct AS (
    SELECT MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS max_pct
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
      AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT frpm."School Name" AS school_name,
       (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat_score
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
JOIN maxpct ON 1=1
WHERE frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" = maxpct.max_pct
  AND satscores.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND satscores.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
  AND (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT
    f."School Name",
    s.AvgScrRead,
    s.AvgScrMath,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" DESC

WITH max_free AS (
    SELECT f."CDSCode",
           f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_pct
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
max_free_val AS (
    SELECT MAX(free_pct) AS max_free_pct FROM max_free
),
top_schools AS (
    SELECT mf."CDSCode"
    FROM max_free mf
    JOIN max_free_val mv ON mf.free_pct = mv.max_free_pct
),
sat_filter AS (
    SELECT s."cds"
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s."NumGE1500" > 0
)
SELECT sc."School" AS school_name,
       sa."AvgScrRead",
       sa."AvgScrMath",
       sa."AvgScrWrite"
FROM top_schools ts
JOIN sat_filter sf ON ts."CDSCode" = sf."cds"
JOIN schools sc ON ts."CDSCode" = sc."CDSCode"
JOIN satscores sa ON ts."CDSCode" = sa."cds";

frpm_13 AS (

    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2013-14'
),

    FROM frpm

JOIN sat_filtered s ON s.cds = f13.CDSCode;

SELECT s.sname AS school_name,
       s.AvgScrMath AS avg_math_score
FROM satscores AS s

WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015';
